convert.explanation: Convert captured triangle, tetrahedral and eight-node hexahedral meshes between ASCII VTU and legacy VTK 4.2, checking units, ordered connectivity and scalar/vector arrays independently. Useful for CAE volume interchange and post-processing handoffs.
pitfalls: Only coordinates change units; scalar/vector array units are not inferred.
Strict subset refuses binary/compressed payloads and unsupported metadata instead of silently losing them.
Hexahedra follow VTK type 12 node order. Positive Jacobians at eight corners, centre and eight Gauss points are a bounded geometry check, not proof of global positivity or mesh quality.

examples.purpose: Mixed-cell millimetre VTU to metre VTK.
Affine hexahedron plus tetra/triangle: mm to m, 24 mm cubed hex volume.
Warped hex: cm to mm, independent 25.5 mm cubed trilinear volume.

fields.explanation: Declare one strict ASCII mesh conversion with explicit source/target length units. The route preserves ordered topology and scalar/vector point/cell values, scales coordinates alone and refuses unsupported information before native execution.

/properties/version.explanation: Use schemaxis.meshio/1 for the document contract; native meshio 5.3.5 is a separate runtime version.

/properties/operation.explanation: Choose convert to read a captured supported mesh, convert coordinate units and write the selected ASCII format. Same-format unit conversion is valid.

/properties/source.explanation: Required absolute local .vtu/.vtk regular file, matching sourceFormat, at most 16 MiB. No symlinks, devices or remote fetching. Bytes are captured and hashed; same-path changes invalidate reuse. Supported cells are linear triangle, tetra and VTK-order eight-node hexahedron; export high-order/voxel/wedge/pyramid cells through an explicit separate preparation step.

/properties/sourceFormat.explanation: Required vtu or vtk. vtu means a single inline ASCII UnstructuredGrid Piece; vtk means legacy 4.2 ASCII unstructured grid with FIELD arrays. The extension must match. Binary, appended, compressed and extra metadata sections are refused.

/properties/targetFormat.explanation: Required vtu or vtk ASCII output, at most 32 MiB. Select the format the downstream consumer accepts. Ordered geometry/connectivity and supported arrays are preserved; dtype, block grouping and formatting may change.

/properties/sourceUnits.explanation: Required coordinate length unit: m, cm, mm, in. Declare the unit already used by source XYZ; no inference from filename or scalar/vector fields. Incorrect declarations rescale an otherwise valid mesh incorrectly.

/properties/targetUnits.explanation: Required output coordinate unit: m, cm, mm, in. XYZ including origin is multiplied by source metres-per-unit divided by target metres-per-unit. mm to m is 0.001; tetra volume changes by the cube. Field values are never rescaled.

/properties/lossPolicy.explanation: Required strict: reject unsupported metadata, cell types or data arrays rather than dropping them. Strict preserves declared numeric/ordering semantics; it does not preserve ASCII formatting, numeric storage dtype or meshio block boundaries.
